story.soThat: all subsequent SDK development has a solid foundation to build upon
story.tasks: - Create package structure under packages/common/ - Organize namespace folders (/plugin, /provider, /holo, /utils) - Configure TypeScript for clean builds with declaration files - Set up package.json with metadata and subpath exports - Integrate build scripts with monorepo tooling - Create README with documentation - Add index files for each namespace - Include license file - Configure .npmignore

story-context.acceptanceCriteria: - Package structure created under packages/common/ - Namespace folders organized (/plugin, /provider, /holo, /utils) - TypeScript configuration for clean builds with declaration files - Package.json with proper metadata and subpath exports - Build scripts integrated with monorepo tooling - README with basic documentation and usage examples - Index files for each namespace with proper exports - License file (MIT or Apache 2.0) included - .npmignore configured to exclude source files - Package builds successfully with npm run build

story-context.constraints: - ADR-001: Namespaced + Subpath Exports pattern - No imports from src/ or packages/core/ (IP boundary) - Tree-shakeable export structure - TypeScript 5.0+ compatibility - Node 18+ compatibility - Start at version 0.1.0 for initial development - Use package.json exports field for clean imports - Must emit clean .d.ts files for TypeScript consumers

tests.standards: Use Jest for unit testing, verify imports work correctly, test that TypeScript types are accessible
